rulesStrings.li: questDescription->After contact with the Foundation, your terminal received a sealed archive fragment marked 001. Accept the assignment and keep a Foundation communications terminal powered at this settlement for one day of accumulated decryption time. A power outage pauses the work. The fragment may explain why an internal O5 file was hidden from your site.

li.label: Project 001 fragment decoded
li.text: The complete fragment is now available in Terminal → Journal → Foundation Archive.
